scripts.dev: node scripts/check-deps.cjs && node scripts/run-with-log.cjs --name dev -- pnpm dev:raw
scripts.dev:log: node scripts/check-deps.cjs && node scripts/run-with-log.cjs --name dev -- pnpm dev:raw
scripts.dev:desktop:shell: node scripts/wait-for-port.cjs --port 3000 && node scripts/wait-for-port.cjs --port 5173 && pnpm --filter @0xnovelagent/desktop dev
scripts.dev:desktop: node scripts/check-deps.cjs && node scripts/run-with-log.cjs --name desktop-dev -- pnpm dev:desktop:raw
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @0xnovelagent/shared build && pnpm --filter @0xnovelagent/server build && pnpm --filter @0xnovelagent/client build
scripts.verify:relay-contract: pnpm --filter @0xnovelagent/shared build && pnpm --filter @0xnovelagent/server build && node --test server/tests/relayServices.test.js server/tests/relayLlmContract.test.js server/tests/consumerProductBoundary.test.js
scripts.build:desktop:all: pnpm --filter @0xnovelagent/shared build && pnpm --filter @0xnovelagent/server prisma:generate && pnpm --filter @0xnovelagent/server build && pnpm --filter @0xnovelagent/client build:desktop && pnpm --filter @0xnovelagent/desktop build
scripts.stage:desktop: pnpm run verify:consumer-release && pnpm run verify:relay-contract && pnpm run build:desktop:all && node desktop/scripts/stage-desktop.cjs
scripts.dist:desktop:nsis: pnpm run stage:desktop && node desktop/scripts/run-electron-builder.cjs --win nsis --x64
scripts.dist:desktop:portable: pnpm run stage:desktop && node desktop/scripts/run-electron-builder.cjs --win portable --x64
scripts.verify:desktop-package: pnpm run stage:desktop && node desktop/scripts/run-electron-builder.cjs --dir --win --x64 && node desktop/scripts/verify-desktop-package.cjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @0xnovelagent/shared build && pnpm --filter @0xnovelagent/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @0xnovelagent/client typecheck && pnpm --filter @0xnovelagent/desktop typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @0xnovelagent/shared lint && pnpm --filter @0xnovelagent/server lint && pnpm --filter @0xnovelagent/client lint
